Name: Meat And Burgers
Author: OwlandJoy
Description:
[b][size=6]🍔 Meat & Burgers[/size][/b]
Bring a classic burger menu to Stardew Valley with delicious homemade meals, refreshing sodas, and satisfying new recipes! Whether you're cooking for a busy day on the farm or grabbing a quick bite from Gus, every meal comes with its own tasty benefits.
[heading][color=#ea9999] Features[/color][/heading]
🍔 Burgers
[list]
[*][b]Beef Burger[/b][/*]
[*][b]Chicken Burger[/b][/*]
[*][b]Double Beef Burger[/b] [i](Includes customizable stat bonus selection)[/i][/*]
[*][b]Double Chicken Burger[/b] [i](Includes customizable stat bonus selection)[/i][/*]
[/list]🍟 Sides
[list]
[*][b]Small Fries[/b][/*]
[*][b]Medium Fries[/b][/*]
[*][b]Large Fries[/b][/*]
[/list]🥤 Drinks
[list]
[*][b]Cola[/b][/*]
[*][b]Orange Soda[/b][/*]
[*][b]Lemon Soda[/b][/*]
[/list]🥩 Ingredients
[list]
[*][b]Beef[/b][/*]
[*][b]Chicken[/b][/*]
[/list][heading][color=#ea9999]Gameplay Mechanics[/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Burgers:[/b] Restore energy and provide useful buffs.[/*]
[*][b]Double Burgers:[/b] Allow you to choose your own stat bonus.[/*]
[*][b]Fries:[/b] Restore both health and energy.[/*]
[*][b]Sodas:[/b] Grant a [b]Sugar Rush[/b] (+2 Speed), followed by a [b]Sugar Crash[/b] (-1 Speed).[/*]
[*][b]Flavor Text:[/b] Enjoy random flavor text every time you eat or drink.[/*]
[*][b]Availability:[/b] Purchase items directly from [b]Gus's Saloon[/b] or cook them yourself using the included recipes.[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#ea9999]Requirements & Installation[/color][/heading]
Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI (Latest version)[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract both folders directly into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and enjoy![/*]
[/list][heading][color=#ea9999]Credits & Support [/color][b][color=#e4e4e7][size=2]Created by:[/size][/color][/b][color=#e4e4e7][size=2] Owljoy :D[/size][/color][/heading]
Thank you to everyone who downloads, plays, and supports this mod! If you enjoy it and would like to support future updates, you can buy me a coffee on [b][url=https://ko-fi.com/owljoy]Ko-fi[/url][/b]. Every bit of support helps me create more content for the Stardew Valley community. Thank you!

[heading][color=#ea9999]Suggestions & Feedback!![/color][/heading]
I'd love to hear your ideas!
If you have a suggestion, feel free to leave it in the comments. I read every suggestion, and if I think it fits the mod, I'll happily add it in a future update.
Some ideas may even become [b]Ko-fi exclusive early-access updates[/b] before they're released publicly on Nexus.
